question: In what condition does the speaker find their body at the present time?
premises: The speaker refers to their own body.
The body is pure by nature.
At present it is struck by a veil of ignorance.
inference: The speaker's pure body is currently afflicted by a veil of ignorance.
uncertainties: No remedy is stated in this verse.
plain_english: Today my pure body is struck by a veil of ignorance.
